pick.headline: Earthquake devastates Soviet Armenia
pick.summary: On December 7, 1988, an earthquake struck northern Armenia, destroying Spitak and much of Leninakan and killing about 25,000 people.
pick.significance: Gorbachev cut short his visit to the United States, and for the first time the Soviet Union accepted large-scale Western aid, including from America.

alternates.headline: Gorbachev announces troop cuts at the United Nations
alternates.summary: On December 7, 1988, Mikhail Gorbachev told the UN General Assembly that the Soviet Union would cut its armed forces by half a million men, including withdrawals from Eastern Europe.
alternates.significance: The unilateral cuts signaled Moscow would no longer hold Eastern Europe by force.
